name: Noémie Merlant
bio: Noémie Merlant (born 27 November 1988) is a French actress. She has been nominated three times at the César Awards, including a nomination for her breakout role in Portrait of a Lady on Fire (2019) and a win for The Innocent (2022).

He drifts until a traveling circus takes him in, a place where everything has a role, and staying means learning how to fit into one.
